prose:
A New Yorker essay examines religious and apocalyptic language surrounding AI, using reported examples and personal reflection to explore how people interpret nonhuman intelligence. The opening juxtaposes promises of abundance with fears of catastrophe.

Only part of the long article was examined here. Its cultural framing and descriptions of beliefs are not proof of an organization’s motives or evidence that any particular theological or technological forecast is true.
highlights: Essay explores belief and rhetoric around AI
Personal narrative differs from reported claims
Opening contrasts utopian and catastrophic expectations
This summary covers examined passages only
Beliefs are not technical predictions with verified probabilities
